title: The Story of Super Mario Bros. 3
summary: A Gaming Historian documentary on the creation of Super Mario Bros. 3, the hype around its release and why it is regarded as one of the greatest games. It runs about 50 minutes in three parts.
why: HN mentions it for the game design history it contains and as part of a list of good gaming history channels.
